Subject: SignalCrest: pre-sales architecture deep-dive

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the discovery call yesterday — great context on your inference volume and the compliance constraints. Per our talk, the next best step is a focused architecture deep-dive so we can validate topology choices (dedicated vs. hosted), expected latency under your 95th percentile QPS, and any network/security controls for your VPC setup.

Can you do one of the following 90-minute windows? I included a suggested internal attendee (Ben) so we can cover routing and pricing implications in the same session. All times are PDT:

- Thu May 25, 2028 — 09:00–10:30
- Thu May 25, 2028 — 13:00–14:30
- Fri May 26, 2028 — 08:30–10:00

Proposed attendees from Redwood: Jonas Weber (Solutions), Ben Carter (Pre-sales/Infra). From SignalCrest: engineering lead + network/security.

Goals for the session (suggested):
- Validate expected latency & throughput for your peak inference patterns
- Discuss routing/fallback policies across regions and Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs
- Walk through Private deployment networking & audit/logging requirements
- Outline action items + sandbox environment needs for a hands-on runbook

If those windows don't work, please suggest two times that do and whether you prefer 60 or 90 minutes — we can compress the agenda. Also let us know if you want us to bring a brief topology diagram in the invite or share a pre-read.

Thanks,
Jonas

Perfect — thanks for the confirmation and for adding Tom. 60 minutes works; we'll tighten the agenda.

Quick answers: we usually don't require inbound firewall openings for the hosted API demo; for Private (VPC) runs we ask for a single egress to a managed endpoint and, if you want to exercise peering, a temporary peering/authorized CIDR may be necessary — I'll bring exact network endpoints to the meeting so Tom can validate.

Draft 60-minute agenda:
- 00:00–00:10 — Goals & success criteria (SignalCrest)
- 00:10–00:30 — Topology options and latency implications (Redwood)
- 00:30–00:45 — KV caching, batching, and cost tradeoffs (Redwood + Q&A)
- 00:45–00:55 — Security: SSO/SCIM, audit logs, and network access
- 00:55–01:00 — Next steps + action items

I'll send a calendar invite once we lock the exact slot. Are you on Zoom or do you prefer Google Meet?

Thanks,
Jonas
